0401e0d73cf3a02f171281c510d04f6a.overview: Low-level bureaucrat Sam Lowry escapes the monotony of his day-to-day life through a recurring daydream of himself as a virtuous hero saving a beautiful damsel. Investigating a case that led to the wrongful arrest and eventual death of an innocent man instead of wanted terrorist Harry Tuttle, he meets the woman from his daydream, and in trying to help her gets caught in a web of mistaken identities, mindless bureaucracy and lies.
0401e0d73cf3a02f171281c510d04f6a.tagline: It's only a state of mind.

04113efc37626f8bbddf576797feab58.overview: A neurotic, twice-divorced sci-fi writer moves back in with his mother to solve his personal problems.

042744bf1592b22df0928acda0c78608.overview: A truly amazing, fantastical, science fiction, funny and odd, and sometimes scary, sad and endearing anthology series presented by Steven Spielberg with guest appearances by many famous actors, actresses, and directors.

04379c2af4cd9acdf9ffd9edf4dc6b7c.overview: A hard-working mother inches towards disaster as she divorces her husband and starts a successful restaurant business to support her spoiled daughter.
04379c2af4cd9acdf9ffd9edf4dc6b7c.tagline: Please don't tell anyone what Mildred Pierce did!

04574666c9ddee92e355f4980458a776.overview: San Francisco's Richmond District. A widow welcomes the Chinese New Year. 62 years old, she wants to make a trip to China to pay last respects to her ancestors. A fortune teller has told her this is the year she'll die, and a daughter, Geraldine, remains unmarried. Geraldine's boyfriend lives in Los Angeles and she's not sure she's ready for marriage, nor does she want to leave her mother alone in her declining years. Mrs. Tan's cheerful brother-in-law, Uncle Tam, tries to help out.

048355ac950bf1966767103d4fa75964.overview: The deformed Phantom who haunts the Paris Opera House causes murder and mayhem in an attempt to make the woman he loves a star.
048355ac950bf1966767103d4fa75964.tagline: The greatest horror film of modern cinema!

04ce3af2a26942c73fd2ba95df632e06.overview: In 1920s Chicago, Italian immigrant and notorious thug, Antonio 'Tony' Camonte, aka Scarface, shoots his way to the top of the mobs while trying to protect his sister from the criminal life.
04ce3af2a26942c73fd2ba95df632e06.tagline: The rise and fall of a power hungry mobster.

04dc7c85abac31fc2158ead3c4487c1e.overview: Follow the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a path of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe, Paul endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

04dfa26972b1b125c7b41b4edc581b2e.overview: Following the murder of her father by a hired hand, a 14-year-old farm girl sets out to capture the killer. To aid her, she hires the toughest U.S. Marshal she can find—a man with 'true grit'—Reuben J. 'Rooster' Cogburn.
04dfa26972b1b125c7b41b4edc581b2e.tagline: Punishment comes one way or another.

04ede14c8dc9d58da4dc41a4d85692b3.overview: Amateur plumber Cluny Brown gets sent off by her uncle to work as a servant at an English country estate.
04ede14c8dc9d58da4dc41a4d85692b3.tagline: At Last...The Stars You've Wanted - In Each Other's Arms!

04f5a2c62632d539347b20e9fdbf1be1.overview: Recently paroled from prison, legendary burglar "Doc" Riedenschneider, with funding from Alonzo Emmerich, a crooked lawyer, gathers a small group of veteran criminals together in the Midwest for a big jewel heist.
